hard_deny: Never restore, delete or import a Cloudflare D1 database: no wrangler d1 time-travel restore, no wrangler d1 delete, no D1 import or time_travel call through the API or any MCP tool. This app has no database of its own; the site's is the one every rider's rides are in, and a restore throws away everything written since the point it goes back to. Those are the owner's to run from their own terminal.
